## Context / immutable audit base
At d49fea41cc383dc70d465903e94598a6dc790bd1, these four files contain 13 confirmed prose blocks that can be condensed without behavior change. The former older-SHA ranges mixed prose and code and missed four long owner docstrings/comments. Lines are immutable-base citations, not edit coordinates.

## Exact prose allowlist
A stable ID is the full path plus :: plus the listed suffix. Only these blocks may change.

- src/rebar/_io/_cli.py (3): module-docstring@1-7; export_cli::comment(The factory is the parser of record)@29-37; import_cli::comment(Factory is the parser of record)@102-106.
- src/rebar/_io/_provenance.py (3): module-docstring@1-8; _coerce_ns-docstring@16-25; create_kwargs-docstring@35-45.
- src/rebar/_io/_strip.py (1): module-docstring@1-15.
- src/rebar/_io/import_ndjson.py (6): module-docstring@1-39; _scan_existing_source_ids-docstring@93-97; import_tickets-docstring@123-134; import_tickets::comment(Chunk size for the batched-commit flush)@184-189; import_tickets::comment(transition_core requires a bounded class)@356-361; import_tickets::comment(Every closeable ticket is still open here)@370-376.

## Contracts, consumers, and exclusions
Preserve the argparse-inexpressible token rules and error/output channels; exact nanosecond coercion; source-versus-local-genesis provenance; provider key/comment-id stripping while retaining source_* fields; two-pass/sub-phase ordering; source_id idempotence; chunk boundaries; deferred push; children-before-parents; and the ordinary-close/no-force invariant. Real consumers are export/import CLI handlers and the locked write/reducer paths; no allowlisted docstring is read via __doc__ or inspect.getdoc in the audited tree.

All non-allowlisted prose and all runtime strings, assertions, fixtures, decorators, subprocess arguments, config values/keys, directives, and shebangs remain byte-identical. Preserve _cli.py T201 directives at lines 66/67/86/116/117/123/124/137/139; import_ndjson.py read-via directives at 216/217/395 and BLE001 directives at 290/306/312/330/348/353/385.

## Verification and independent review
Parse base/final Python with type_comments=True; strip only allowlisted owner docstrings, normalize only ast.TypeIgnore.lineno, and require remaining AST/runtime equality. Require directive/shebang physical-line equality and exact HEAD^..HEAD paths. Run focused IO contracts, path diff-check, and hygiene locally. Under the operator comments-only waiver, Gerrit Verified +1 substitutes for local make verify and supplies the full CI gate.

A non-author reviewer records a leaf-linked TSV with exactly 13 PASS rows: stable_id, before_citation, final_citation, preserved_contract_or_consumer, directives_exact, before_words, final_words, reviewer_session, semantic_pass, bloat_pass. Every block must shrink; missing/extra/FAIL rows block closure.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Exactly the 13 allowlisted blocks are shortened; no other prose or directive changes.
- [x] The immutable AST/runtime and directive oracle passes for all four files.
- [x] [non-codebase] Every listed parsing, provenance, stripping, ordering, batching, and close contract has an independent-review PASS citation.
      provenance: environment=local review worktree with immutable and Gerrit-merged Git objects; principal=/root/resume-20260908-ad60-independent-review; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=static-analysis — the non-author reviewer resolved and compared every before/final block, so any omitted or changed contract would produce a non-PASS row
- [x] HEAD^..HEAD changes exactly the four declared paths and the first five structured verify commands pass.
- [x] [non-codebase] The independent TSV has exactly exactly 13 complete="X" rows with lower final word counts.
      provenance: environment=local review worktree with immutable and Gerrit-merged Git objects; principal=/root/resume-20260908-ad60-independent-review; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=static-analysis — the receipt generator enforced 13 unique rows, complete citations and PASS fields, and strict per-row shrink before the review was posted
